metadata.question: Were blooms of phytoplankton visible in the Norwegian Sea during June 5, 2019?

data.exec_msg:
Dataset: NASA/OCEANDATA/MODIS-Aqua/L3SMI
Date window: 2019-06-05 to 2019-06-06, Images: 1
Valid pixels: 8746 of 123988 (cov: 7.1%)
Chl-a median: 1.05 mg/m^3
Chl-a p90: 1.76 mg/m^3
Bloom >2 mg/m^3: 490 px (5.6%)
A
